customers.stories.title: Invoice processing cut from 3 days to 4 hours
customers.stories.does: Reads 6,000 supplier invoices a month, checks tax numbers and posts entries into SAP.
customers.stories.quote: We went live in five weeks. Our AP team now spends its time on exceptions, not data entry.

customers.stories.title: Shipment updates across 14 carrier portals, hands-free
customers.stories.does: Logs into carrier portals every hour, pulls tracking status and updates the TMS and customer emails.
customers.stories.quote: Customers get updates before they even ask. That has changed how our support team works.

customers.stories.title: Insurance pre-authorisation in minutes, not hours
customers.stories.does: Collects patient details from the HIS, fills insurer portals and tracks approval status for every admission.
customers.stories.quote: Patients are discharged faster and our billing desk is no longer the bottleneck.

customers.stories.title: Policy renewals processed overnight
customers.stories.does: Generates renewal quotes, sends reminders and issues policies once payment is confirmed.
customers.stories.quote: Renewals used to need a team of twenty at quarter-end. Now it runs overnight.

customers.stories.title: Purchase orders and stock kept in sync with accounting
customers.stories.does: Raises purchase orders, reconciles goods receipts and keeps the accounting system and the warehouse sheet in sync.
customers.stories.quote: Our team built their first agents themselves after two days of training.

customers.stories.title: Marketplace orders from 6 channels into one ERP
customers.stories.does: Downloads orders from marketplaces, creates them in the ERP and pushes back invoices and tracking numbers.
customers.stories.quote: We doubled order volume in peak season without adding back-office staff.

home.steps.label: Intake
home.steps.title: The agent starts the moment the invoice arrives
home.steps.detail: An email trigger picks up the supplier’s PDF and adds it to a work queue, so nothing waits for someone to notice it.

home.steps.label: Read and extract
home.steps.title: Every field is read, whatever the layout
home.steps.detail: Supplier name, tax ID, line items, totals and due date are extracted from scanned or digital invoices.

home.steps.label: Validate
home.steps.title: Mismatches are caught before they reach your books
home.steps.detail: The agent checks the tax ID, matches the purchase order and flags anything that doesn’t add up.

home.steps.label: Post to ERP
home.steps.title: Entered into your ERP, the way your team would
home.steps.detail: A One Runner on your machines enters the invoice into SAP or your ERP, with every step audited.

home.steps.label: Human review
home.steps.title: People step in only for exceptions
home.steps.detail: Mismatches arrive in a reviewer’s Task inbox with the invoice and the reason attached.

sections.heading: Who we are
items: This policy explains how {legalName} (“OneOfficeAutomation”, “we”, “us”) handles personal information on {website} and in the customer accounts you create here. We are a company incorporated in Karnataka, India (CIN {cin}) with our registered office at {address}, and an office in Doha, Qatar.
It covers our website only. The OneOfficeAutomation platform is self-hosted: the business data your agents process stays on your own servers and is not sent to us.

sections.heading: Information we collect
items: Account details you give us when you register: name, work email, company, country, chosen plan and a password. We store only a salted, one-way hash of your password.
Details you send through our forms: demo requests, partner applications and newsletter sign-ups, including anything you write in the message box.
Messages and calls with our sales and support teams.
Technical and usage information, such as pages visited and device type, but only if you accept analytics cookies.
Your cookie choices, stored in your browser.

sections.heading: How we use it
items: To create and run your account and keep it secure.
To respond to demo, partner and support requests.
To send product updates you asked for. You can unsubscribe at any time.
To understand how the site is used and improve it, with your consent where required.
To meet legal, tax and security obligations.

sections.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
items: Essential cookies keep the site working, for example the session cookie that keeps you signed in. They are always on.

Analytics and marketing cookies stay off until you accept them in the cookie banner. You can change your choice at any time by clearing the site data in your browser, after which the banner appears again.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
items: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us run the website, such as hosting and email providers, under confidentiality and security obligations, and with authorities when the law requires it.
If we are involved in a merger, acquisition or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction, and we will tell you if that happens.

sections.heading: International transfers
items: We operate from India and Qatar, and our service providers may process data in other countries. Where we transfer personal information across borders, we use safeguards that the applicable law permits.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
items: We keep account information while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards for legal and accounting purposes. Form submissions are kept only as long as needed to handle your request. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

sections.heading: How we protect it
